section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes instruments used in the present study: a 2-item exercise behavior index from the Exercise Behaviour Survey, the Body Esteem Scale (BES) with body-as-process and body-as-object subscales and two single-item orientation measures (process vs appearance), Avalos et al.'s (2005) 13-item Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), and body-related talk scales (6 items for exercise talk; 3 items for weight-loss/diet talk). Cronbach's alphas for these measures are reported; no sample demographics, recruitment source, BMI assessment method, or correlation coefficients between body appreciation and BMI are provided here.
